Thyroid Gland Th e thyroid gland, which is responsible
for controlling metabolic rate, lies over the trachea just below 
the larynx, and consists of two lobes connected by a thin strip 
called the isthmus (see Figure 17.4).1
Th e thyroid hormones are two iodine-containing hormones 
derived from the amino acid tyrosine: thyroxine (T4 or
tetraiodothyronine) and triiodothyrone (T3). Th e preﬁ xes
tetra- and tri- and subscripts 4 and 3 denote the number of 
iodine atoms incorporated into each of these hormones. T4
